text.approach: From High Bridge, take the Park Creek trail up the Park Creek valley and climb to the snow line on the south side of the saddle between Goode and Storm King; the first party camped there. Gain the saddle, make one rappel onto the glacier on the north side, and descend it through crevasses and beneath an ice cliff to the foot of the roughly 3,000 ft rock rib that leads straight to the main (east) summit. Expect a bivy at the base of the rib.

text.overview: A rarely repeated technical line up Storm King's north face, first climbed in 1978 by Dick Emerson and Walter Gove. Unlike the walk-up-style Southwest Route, this is a genuine technical alpine rock climb, but little is known about its grade, pitch count, and exact line.
